notes.title: AI update!
notes.notes:
Lots of AI fixes and tweaking.
Protectors (bugs and bulldogs) now have weaker weapons (but not "weak").
Player's weapon unlocks have more sense now (theoretically the more you play, the better the weapon).
All bots now have medium quality weapons.
Protectors spawn was fixed (sometimes they were too slow to enable shields).
And some more fixes.
Let me know in the forums if something is wrong.

So, what's next?
New game mode ;)

Droo.
